propositions: Batch-path verdicts systematically return confidence=0.0 because the JSON Schema contract had no required fields, causing the model to omit confidence and default it to 0.0, falling below the 0.7 threshold and preventing aggregate from surfacing any findings.
Output token limit of 1024 bytes truncates multi-candidate batches (up to 20 candidates → 10-pair batches), causing truncated responses to abstain the whole batch rather than return verdicts.

The batch entry contract now requires candidate_id, relation, confidence, and abstain fields (shared_artifact remains nullable), and output budget scales to 256 + 192*n tokens per batch to accommodate real verdicts without truncation.
Live calibration confirmed that near-duplicate pairs in full batches now surface with confidence ≥0.95 after the contract and token budget fixes, while unrelated pairs remain unsurfaced at 0.97-0.98.
